version: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations, Gao et al., EMNLP 2023, December 2023, pp. 6465–6488, DOI 10.18653/v1/2023.emnlp-main.398; sections 3.3–3.4 and Limitations
license: CC-BY-4.0 (paper; ACL Anthology publication page states materials published in or after 2016 use CC BY 4.0: https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.398/)
purpose: Original author research: citation recall measures support of generated statements; citation precision penalizes irrelevant citations with recall prerequisite and does not demand a minimal citation set. Citation-only scores do not measure answer completeness; NLI partial-support limitation. No code, dataset, prompts, figures, or benchmark scores copied.
